title: 第23章 准武者，皂衣捕快
novel_title: 乱世武道：从山村猎户开始狂肝箭术
content_zh:
陆林起床洗漱一番，就开始修炼。

    先从连珠箭开始。

    连续两箭射出。

    经验增加五点。

    再次射出一轮。

    【连珠箭：小有成就（0/50）】

    陆林看到眼前突然出现的光幕，这才意识到不对劲。

    连那突然出现，能够改变身体的热流都没有在意。

    “怎么回事，我才射两次，连珠箭就升级了。”

    陆林可没有忘记，他之前修炼箭术，要射出二十箭才能增加一点经验。

    保持光幕打开的状态。

    陆林再次射箭。

    【连珠箭：小有成就（5/50）】

    一次就涨了五点！

    这是什么情况？

    陆林自己一下都懵了。

    双手机械式的射箭，不一会，光幕上的信息再次刷新。

    【连珠箭：熟能生巧（0/200）】

    一股热流出现，在陆林身上游走一圈。

    缓缓的提升他的身体能力。

    陆林现在确认了，他真的射一次箭，就能提升五点经验。

    相应的，连珠箭升级两次后，陆林的悟性也增加五点。

    【悟性：38】

    当陆林再次拿箭在手中，感觉瞬间就不一样了。

    他感觉自己一次能射出五支箭。

    尝试了一番。

    陆林发现五支箭射出，准头会差一些，三支箭正好。

    可以随着陆林的心意，或者是射中一个目标，或者是射中三个陆林指定的目标。

    不知不觉间，连珠箭的经验再次充满。

    【悟性：42】

    【连珠箭：登堂入室（5/1000）】

    刚才梁心兰起床去做早饭。

    可就这么会功夫，陆林的连珠箭竟然接连进境。

    那一股突然出现的热流，也让陆林有了感觉。

    他的力量在增加。

    视力变得更强。

    陆林突然有一种冲动，今天不出门，一直修炼连珠箭，看它能提升到什么程度。

    只是愿望是美好的。

    刚吃过早饭，几个村里的长辈就上门。

    任忠武也在。

    “任大人！”
content_en:
Lu Lin got up, washed up, and started practicing.

    Let’s start with the chain of arrows.

    Shoot two arrows in succession.

    Increase experience by five points.

    Shoot another round.

    [Running Arrows: Small Achievements (0/50)]

    Lu Lin saw the light curtain suddenly appearing in front of him and realized something was wrong.

    He didn't even pay attention to the heat that suddenly appeared and could change his body.

    "What's going on? I only shot twice and my volley of arrows has been upgraded."

    Lu Lin has not forgotten that he used to practice archery and had to shoot twenty arrows to gain some experience.

    Keep the light curtain open.

    Lu Lin shot again.

    [Running Arrows: Small Achievements (5/50)]

    It rose five points in one go!

    What is going on?

    Lu Lin himself was stunned.

    Shooting arrows mechanically with both hands, after a while, the information on the light screen was refreshed again.

    [Running Arrows: Practice makes perfect (0/200)]

    A stream of heat appeared and traveled around Lu Lin's body.

    Slowly improve his physical abilities.

    Lu Lin now confirmed that if he really shoots an arrow, he can gain five points of experience.

    Correspondingly, after upgrading the Lianzhu Arrow twice, Lu Lin's comprehension also increased by five points.

    【Comprehension: 38】

    When Lu Lin held the arrow in his hand again, his feeling was instantly different.

    He felt like he could shoot five arrows at once.

    Tried it.

    Lu Lin found that if five arrows were shot, the accuracy would be slightly off, but three arrows would be just right.

    You can follow Lu Lin's wish, either to hit one target, or to hit three targets specified by Lu Lin.

    Unknowingly, the experience of Lianzhujian was filled again.

    【Comprehension: 42】

    [Running Arrows: Entering the House (5/1000)]

    Just now Liang Xinlan got up to make breakfast.

    But with such a good kung fu, Lu Lin's continuous arrows actually entered the country one after another.

    The sudden heat flow also made Lu Lin feel it.

    His strength is increasing.

    Vision becomes stronger.

    Lu Lin suddenly had the urge not to go out today, but to practice continuous arrows to see how far he could improve.

    It’s just that the wishes are good.

    Just after breakfast, several elders from the village came to visit.

    Ren Zhongwu is also there.

    "Lord Ren!"
